title: Locus layout
description: requests/<iid>/layout.json. The only file the fixer agent may edit. See docs/contracts.md §1. The profile's default is tools/prints/layout-A.json (D4).

labelOffsets.description: Per-point label offsets [dxMm, dyMm] from the point to the centre of its label, keyed by point id (e.g. "vertex", "turning-point-1").

defaultLabelOffset.description: Offset [dxMm, dyMm] for points without an entry in labelOffsets.
